notes: Qemica now finds the Python engine it just installed (an exported build resolved the sidecar to a path only valid inside its own application package, so a correctly installed environment still reported "engine not detected"), and the third-party licenses open again from the account menu. Also: a Quantum tab in Analyze that graphs the measurement outcomes behind a quantum energy, a repaired 3D viewport (outline, lighting, atom-layer resize), an update check pointed at qemica-lab.com, and a smaller download. Windows groundwork landed as well — a managed WSL2 environment, a first-run setup gate and DPI scaling — but Windows builds are not published yet. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
